known_before_freeze: Public seven-source study already reports all candidate actions0, selectionsnull, three confirmation gatesfalse,1027 accepted weak updates per arm. Those totals are prior information; new row/column/qualification/past/weak decision decomposition not extracted before this freeze. All seven are seen. This audit is descriptive, not independent confirmation or quality acceptance.

definitions.scope: Read BOTH actual candidate arms, both original trials on EACH of seven complete sources:28 histories,6372 trace frames,1593 unique source frames. No discovery/confirmation reselection, frame/window filtering, solver, tracker construction/update, prediction/numerical replay, inference, GT/labels/evaluator, media decode, cache parsing or pickle loading. All other native/observed/projection outputs and states hash-only checked against their original public seals.
definitions.time: At f, own accepted keys and high-match contexts are committed through f-1 only. Query before committing ANY current high/weak accepted observation. Birth registers ownership but never qualifies accepted history. Pre-active means before_update.age_since_update==0; stage age has already incremented1, so never derive active from stage age. Confirmed is the archived pre-update sticky ID>=0 role, not true identity. Prior high contexts may include a competitor subsequently accepted weak at f-1; require separate distinct accepted input receipts. Current/future observations, absence of later pairing, implicit expiry and cross-run native-ID equality cannot provide support.
definitions.matrices: Reuse archived original high matched/free partitions; published zero actions must match each frame before any use. Never rerun assignment. Recompute pure ORIGINAL pinned IoU on recorded float64 predicted boxes and original float32 input boxes; high matrix must match exactly. Weak matrix for original high-free rows must also match exactly. Only additionally derive full high-row versus current weak-input gate mask using same IoU, no new geometry/threshold. Per-frame broad weak-blocked count must match original candidate receipt; accepted/input/operation summary must equal original public receipt.
definitions.availability: Count high-stage calls and native empty no-stage frames separately. For calls publish high rows/columns, matched pairs, free rows/columns, activation columns and four-bit presence mask(row/high-column/free-row/free-column). Role counts active/retained x confirmed/tentative; independent3-bit row prerequisite mask confirmed/strictly-past-accepted/positive-prediction. Free-row qualification and available eligible columns are separate. Empty Cartesian universes are missing opportunities, not rejected proposals.
definitions.birth_funnel: Units are original high-free row/column edges, split active-confirmed/retained-confirmed/tentative. Ordered diagnostic conjunction free_pairs->confirmed->accepted_before->positive_prediction->activation->current_gate->no_weak. Row masks expose overlaps; diagnostic order is bookkeeping, not runtime short-circuit order or causal first cause. Current-gate-qualified edges lost at weak exclusion are PRE-PROPOSAL exclusions, not rejected formed proposals. Remaining admissible graph must be mutually unique in row AND column. Ambiguous edges are nonproposals. Only mutual-unique full-rule edges are qualified proposals; this rule has no post-proposal veto, so rejected-qualified-proposals stays0 and proposals must equal reconstructed actions.
definitions.handoff_funnel: Units are original selected high edge(r,c) x original high-free q triples. Diagnostic conjunction both positive confirmed strictly-past-accepted -> both pre-active -> both accepted at f-1 -> selected high context at f-1 keyed to its own latest accepted update -> q present -> past active-confirmed/gate/margin -> distinct previous inputs -> current gate/margin -> no weak opportunity. All original .05/native gates unchanged. Missing prerequisites are NONPROPOSALS, including missing context. Diagnostic first-nonproposal priority is not causal blame or an exclusive physical incident count. Pair-role16-way counts retain all overlaps. Weak exclusions after all other predicates are preproposal; broad blocked rows alone never count as rejected proposals.
definitions.proposals: For handoff, per-selected-edge zero alternatives and multiple alternatives are nonproposals; exactly one fully admissible alternative forms a qualified proposal. If two such proposals claim the same q, only this ORIGINAL one-to-one claim veto counts rejected qualified proposals. Count selected-edge, triple, admissible-edge, unique-proposal and conflict-proposal units separately. Never turn unconfirmed/no accepted/no prior context/no free slot/weak opportunity into rejected qualified proposals. Primary counters/actions reconcile ONLY to matching original candidate arm, not counterfactual reruns; other predicate calculator output remains local.
definitions.integrity: 28 dense full reads; every accepted event and numerical update operation reconciles to immutable AcceptedLedger. Full original summary/input/event receipts, weak-stage call counts and broad weak-row totals exact. Original two archived trials yield equal new aggregate and deterministic local decision-receipt bytes. Original434 files, earlier772 raw files and complete newly frozen seven-source raw inventory verified before/after; original predictions/native outputs/final states unchanged, old pickle hash only. All prior public/code/rules pinned.
definitions.failure: Refuse output overwrite/retry. Keep all seven rows in original discovery/reserved phase order, including zero sources with zero denominators. Missing/mismatched geometry, original zero action, prefix, runtime, receipt or repeat fails source with null audit, local exception and retained trial status; never substitute0. Old four failures/nulls, incomplete historical discovery, all false replication/confirmation flags stay unchanged.
definitions.publication: Source/arm-level fixed aggregate counters, role/mask/funnel denominators, zeros/nulls, failures and hashes only. Per-frame rows/columns/inputs/native IDs/tokens, accepted keys, contexts, similarities, boxes and full decisions remain ignored local. No true ID/FP/FN/HOTA/benefit/safety/default claim. Inherit official KITTI CC BY-NC-SA3.0 local noncommercial research/attribution, no media or raw distribution/relicensing.
